intro.text: Golden Growers Cooperative (“we,” “us,” “our,” and the “Cooperative”) is a value-added agricultural cooperative association owned by 1,445 members primarily from Minnesota, North Dakota and South Dakota, all of whom deliver corn to the Cooperative for processing. The Cooperative was originally formed in 1994 as a North Dakota agricultural cooperative with the goal of allowing its members to receive additional value from the corn that they grow through the processing of that corn into value-added products, such as corn sweeteners.
